entries.what: Indigenous Peoples' Day: Hana is home on leave, so Elliot takes Theo for a stroller walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk past families visiting the park, then logs the morning feeds and naps in the tracker.
entries.outcome: Theo napped in the stroller; the squeaky wheel got louder.

entries.what: Theo's three crib naps hold at 9, 12:30 and 4, and Elliot checks them against the log over lunch of boxed pasta.
entries.outcome: Schedule held for the second week running.

entries.what: The witching hour hits from 5 to 8 p.m.; Elliot hums the slowed-down ballpark organ tune while Hana does bottles, and they order Phở Bến Thành takeout.
entries.outcome: Theo finally settled at 7:40.

entries.what: Elliot takes the 2 a.m. feed, then does the morning marsh walk with Theo in the stroller before the 9 a.m. nap.
entries.outcome: Theo napped nearly 90 minutes in the crib.

entries.what: Elliot works on the online reassessment-software training module during the 12:30 nap, getting through two sections.
entries.outcome: Module 3 left to finish.

entries.what: Tuesday night baby laundry in the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room, with the baby monitor on his phone.
entries.outcome: Two loads folded; monitor dropped once when the microwave ran back upstairs.

entries.what: Hana mentions that some of her Bayshore State coworkers want to stop by to meet Theo this weekend. Elliot asks the assistant for a polite script declining the visit, saying Hana has a lot going on right now.
entries.outcome: Wrote a friendly decline suggesting a visit later in the fall; Hana never learned he drafted it.

entries.what: Theo's afternoon nap runs long, so Elliot finishes the training module's third section at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Module 3 done.

entries.what: Elliot reviews the week's nap times in the log and notes the wake windows are steady at about 90 minutes.
entries.outcome: Added a note for the weekly summary tab.

entries.what: Thursday baby story time at the library with Kaitlyn's group; Theo stares at the felt puppets and Elliot swaps stroller tips with other parents.
entries.outcome: Got a recommendation for a white-noise app volume setting.

entries.what: Elliot checks the tracker app with Judith and Hana, and notes the bathroom faucet is still dripping and unfixed.
entries.outcome: Decided to wait before nagging Gloria again.

entries.what: Evening crying stretch; Elliot walks the hall with Theo while Hana warms dinner leftovers.
entries.outcome: Theo asleep by 8:15.

entries.what: Elliot takes the 2 a.m. feed and the 9 a.m. nap goes smoothly in the crib; he does a little laundry prep during the nap.
entries.outcome: Smooth morning.

entries.what: Walks Theo to the Ruiz Family Market for a few things, and hears from Thao next door that the St. Anselm 4 West crew heard Greg Holloway is now supporting the new charting system there.
entries.outcome: A quick hallway chat; Elliot got a few tips on swaddles.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry at Marisol Gardens, then Judith's weekend schedule means she drives home at 5 p.m.
entries.outcome: Judith left after reminding him where she moved the mugs.

entries.what: Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier; Elliot picks up oat milk and diapers come by delivery.
entries.outcome: Theo slept in the carrier the whole trip.

entries.what: Elliot works on the lighthouse jigsaw at the card table during the 12:30 nap.
entries.outcome: Placed about twenty sky pieces.

entries.what: Elliot and Hana split the evening witching hour, then watch part of a minor-league highlight reel after Theo sleeps.
entries.outcome: Early night for both.

entries.what: Elliot takes the 2 a.m. feed, then a slow Sunday with Hana making scrambled eggs and coffee.
entries.outcome: Family morning at home.

entries.what: Stroller walk on the marsh boardwalk, then puts Theo down for the 12:30 crib nap and plans next week's meals.
entries.outcome: Made a takeout-and-frozen plan for the week, still no real dinner.

entries.what: Sets up Judith's return for Monday morning, tidying up so she finds the kitchen as she left it.
entries.outcome: Kitchen ready.
